name: seqOfForallFinsetExistsAux
statement: Type*} [DecidableEq α] (P : α → Prop) (r : α → α → Prop) (h : ∀ s : Finset α, ∃ y, (∀ x ∈ s, P x) → P y ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, r x y) : ℕ → α | n => Classical.choose (h (Finset.image (fun i : Fin n => seqOfForallFinsetExistsAux P r h i) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))))  /-- Induction principle to build a sequence, by adding one point at a time satisfying a given relation with respect to all the previously chosen points.  More precisely, Assume that, for any finite set `s`, one can find another point satisfying some relation `r` with respect to all the points in `s`. Then one may construct a function `f : ℕ → α` such that `r (f m) (f n)` holds whenever `m < n`. We also ensure that all constructed points satisfy a given predicate `P`. -/ theorem exists_seq_of_forall_finset_exists {α : Type*} (P : α → Prop) (r : α → α → Prop) (h : ∀ s : Finset α, (∀ x ∈ s, P x) → ∃ y, P y ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, r x y) : ∃ f : ℕ → α, (∀ n, P (f n)) ∧ ∀ m n, m < n → r (f m) (f n)
